notes.title: Chinese Language Added to the game.
notes.content:
Release Notes v4.2.0.10

New Features:
1. Chinese Language Support
   - Full game now available in Chinese

2. Language Selection Prompt
   - Game now asks for preferred language at start if system language is not English

3. Expanded Guide Languages
   - Added Spanish and Chinese to the in-game Guide

Developer Notes:
I've done my best to thoroughly test these changes, and your saved games should continue working fine. However, if you encounter any issues, please report them on our forum.

Thank you for your continued support and enjoy the new language options!
